title: Direct Object Pronouns with the Pretérito Indefinido

sections.content: Direct object pronouns replace the person or thing directly affected by the verb. The main forms are lo, la, los and las. In simple past sentences, the pronoun normally comes before the conjugated verb: *Compré* el *regalo* → Lo compré. The pronoun agrees with the object in gender and number.
Choose the pronoun from the object being replaced: el *regalo* → lo, la *tarjeta* → la, los regalos → los, las flores → las.
